summary: Smoke screens billow from their source and thin downwind on high native effects settings. Helicopter downdraft spreads dust low across dry ground, and successive blasts have different silhouettes.
stage: Native Godot 4.7.2, Forward+, high effects, golden lighting, static trenches, seed 3, fixed 30 fps. Three radius-4 screens at 3.8 seconds, dry radius-5 rotor wash at frame 99, and three size-2 bursts at 1.5 seconds. Cosmetic seeds 2383, 2384, and 2381 respectively.
rationale: Matched camera offsets, timing and source positions show the change in plume shape and the footprint of the dust.
source_ref: afe46c41 before, same revision plus the smoke and particle changes after.
